description: Find research funding and papers, save them to your AcaTrove library, and track projects, tasks and deadlines from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
AcaTrove helps researchers find funding and papers and keep their research organized. Search open funding calls and the scholarly literature, save what you find to your AcaTrove library, and manage projects, deadlines and tasks. Changes to research records are made in the user's AcaTrove workspace.

With AcaTrove connected, you can:
- Search funding opportunities across NIH, NSF and other sources, and start a grant application to track one.
- Search papers in Crossref and PubMed, save them to your library, and fetch a legal open-access copy when one exists.
- Search your library and ask questions answered from your own documents, with the source documents named.
- List projects, check project status, and add or update tasks and notes.
- Add, update, and link publications and impact evidence.
- Browse lab samples, resources, and protocol runs.

Grant search and paper search work from your first conversation; the rest fills in as you save your research. AcaTrove only reads and changes records available to the signed-in AcaTrove account, within the permissions granted when you connect. Tools that change or delete records are marked as such so ChatGPT can confirm with you first.
capabilities: Search papers and save them to your library
defaultPrompt: Find open NIH or NSF funding for sleep and memory research. Show the deadlines and who can apply.
Find papers on sleep and memory consolidation and save the most relevant one to my AcaTrove library.
Help me find my published papers and see who is building on my work.

positive.prompt: Find open NIH or NSF funding for sleep and memory research. Show the deadlines and who can apply.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns funding calls and related programs matching the topic from AcaTrove's grant catalog, each with its funder and source and, when known, a deadline and link. Needs no saved records in the account.

positive.description: Search the literature and save one paper after confirmation
positive.prompt: Find papers on sleep and memory consolidation and save the most relevant one to my AcaTrove library.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching papers from Crossref, PubMed and the account's library, asks the user to confirm the write, then saves the chosen paper to the library as a reference and reports the saved record.

positive.description: Explore a researcher’s public record on an empty account
positive.prompt: Help me find my published papers and see who is building on my work.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for a name or ORCID when needed. Ask which author is the user, then show that author’s papers and citing works. Report an empty result or unavailable source explicitly. No record is written.

positive.description: Answer a question from the user's own documents, citing them
positive.prompt: What do the papers in my AcaTrove library say about sleep and memory consolidation? Cite them.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from excerpts of the test account's uploaded papers and names each source document it used.

positive.description: List upcoming deadlines across the user's projects and tasks
positive.prompt: What deadlines do I have in AcaTrove over the next 60 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's upcoming deadlines in the next 60 days, in date order, with the project or task each belongs to.

positive.description: Create a task in a project after confirmation
positive.prompt: Add a task 'Draft methods' to my sleep and memory project, due November 6, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the matching project, asks the user to confirm the write, then creates the task and reports its title, project, and due date.

negative.description: Access to another user's data is refused
negative.prompt: Show me another researcher's AcaTrove library.

negative.description: Unrelated request does not use AcaTrove

review.commerce_description: AcaTrove's ChatGPT tools do not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: All three starter prompts work with an empty library. Find funding, discover papers, or explore who cites your work.
